blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Authorities arrested three of Northern Mindanao’s most wanted fugitives in Misamis Oriental on Tuesday, police said Wednesday. The separate intelligence-driven operations on November 17 led to the capture of three men facing non-bailable charges for rape and illegal drugs, the Police Regional Office 10 (PRO-10) said.
